text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to rescind the existing maximum 15-minute parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Strathburn Boulevard, between a point 137 metres south of Wallasey Avenue and a point 13 metres further south and to prohibit stopping at all times Monday to Friday instead. Also, a stopping prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday is recommended on the east side of Strathburn Boulevard, from Lovilla Boulevard to a point 119 metres north.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum 15-minute parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Strathburn Boulevard, between a point 137 metres south of Wallasey Avenue and a point 13 metres further south. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times Monday to Friday, on the west side of Strathburn Boulevard, between a point 137 metres south of Wallasey Avenue and a point 13 metres further south. 3. Prohibited stopping from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the east side of Strathburn Boulevard, from Lovilla Boulevard to a point 119 metres north.
